outcome: instrument utilization rates for cesarean sections
cohort: The study included 28 cesarean section cases (12 primary, 16 repeat; 11 scheduled, 13 urgent, 4 emergent) from an urban academic hospital.
finding: Current instrument utilization rates in cesarean sections show opportunities for tray optimization, with specific instruments like Ochsner artery forceps and Rich retractors demonstrating differential use based on case urgency.
mod_finding: Total instrument utilization rates did not differ between primary and repeat cesarean cases.
cross-section timing: Data was prospectively collected on instruments used during cesarean sections.
